```{r}
#| label: setup

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(kableExtra)
library(here)

# ---- Load derived data ------------------------------------------------------
# Standalone: reads the output of R/data-analysis/data-analysis.R only.

extract_dttm <- format(params$extract_dttm, scientific = FALSE)
dir_derived  <- here("data/derived", extract_dttm)

f_derived <- if (nzchar(params$derived_file)) {
  params$derived_file
} else {
  # file names are dat-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.qs2 so the last in sort order is the latest
  tail(sort(list.files(dir_derived, pattern = "^dat-.*\\.qs2$")), 1)
}
if (length(f_derived) == 0 || !file.exists(here(dir_derived, f_derived))) {
  stop("No derived data file found in ", dir_derived)
}

# The report only uses the processed data, never the raw extracts. Each element
# is described at the end of main() in the extract script.
l_out <- qs2::qs_read(here(dir_derived, f_derived))
l_cfg <- l_out$l_cfg   # configuration, including the baseline data dictionary
l_dat <- l_out$l_dat   # screening counts
l_pt  <- l_out$l_pt    # participants: reporting population and domain allocation
l_bl  <- l_out$l_bl    # baseline and microbiology
l_po  <- l_out$l_po    # primary outcome
l_d100 <- l_out$l_d100 # day 100 form
l_pd  <- l_out$l_pd    # protocol deviations

cat("Report built from: ", f_derived, "\n", file = stderr())

# ---- Helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------

fmt_n    <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
fmt_pct  <- function(x, digits = 0) paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = digits), "%")
fmt_date <- function(d) sub("^0", "", format(d, "%d %B %Y"))

# escape the characters that LaTeX treats as special
tex_esc <- function(x) gsub("([&%$#_{}])", "\\\\\\1", x)

# plain text (as held in the baseline data dictionary) to a LaTeX label
tex_label <- function(x) {
  x <- tex_esc(x)
  x <- gsub("<", "$<$", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">=", "$\\geq$", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("umol", "$\\mu$mol", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub("([0-9])-([0-9])", "\\1--\\2", x)   # ranges such as 0-48
}

is_dummy <- grepl("dummy", l_cfg$extract$data_dir, fixed = TRUE)

# data cut (extract) date
dt_cut <- l_cfg$version$dt_extract

# primary outcome timing, set in the extract script (l_cfg$d365)
po_day  <- l_cfg$d365$day
po_win  <- l_cfg$d365$window
po_open <- po_day - po_win   # the outcome window opens

# plot defaults
cols_arm <- c("#0072B2", "#E69F00")   # arm 1, arm 2 within a domain (print safe)
theme_set(
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", colour = "grey60"),
      legend.position  = "bottom"
    )
)

# ---- Domains ----------------------------------------------------------------

# domain and treatment possibilities
dm_codes <- names(l_cfg$dm_defn)

d_arm <- rbindlist(lapply(l_cfg$dm_defn, function(d) {
  data.table(
    dm      = d$dm,
    dm_lab  = d$label,
    arm_pos = seq_along(d$trt_map),
    arm     = unname(unlist(d$trt_map))
  )
}))
d_arm[, dm_lab := factor(dm_lab, levels = unique(dm_lab))]

# ---- Randomised participants (platform) -------------------------------------

# l_pt$d_pt is the reporting population made in participants() in the extract
# script: randomised participants that are in the participant list, with the
# site, the date of platform randomisation and the days from randomisation to
# the data extract. The baseline, primary outcome and deviation data are already
# restricted to these participants, so every table has the same denominator.
d_pt <- copy(l_pt$d_pt)
# completed weeks since platform randomisation, at the data extract date
d_pt[, wk := days_rand %/% 7L]

n_rand   <- nrow(d_pt)
n_sites  <- uniqueN(d_pt$site)
dt_first <- min(d_pt$dt_rand)
dt_last  <- max(d_pt$dt_rand)

# ---- Randomised participants by domain --------------------------------------

# l_pt$d_pt_dm has a row for each participant randomised within a domain, with
# the arm. Add the domain label and the participant details used in the plots.
d_dm <- merge(l_pt$d_pt_dm, unique(d_arm[, .(dm, dm_lab)]), by = "dm")
d_dm <- merge(d_dm, d_pt[, .(StudyPtID, dt_rand, site, wk)], by = "StudyPtID")

# counts by domain and arm, including arms with no participants
d_dm_n <- merge(
  d_arm,
  d_dm[, .N, keyby = .(dm, arm)],
  by = c("dm", "arm"), all.x = TRUE
)
d_dm_n[is.na(N), N := 0L]
d_dm_n[, N_dm := sum(N), by = dm]
d_dm_n[, prop := fifelse(N_dm > 0, N / N_dm, NA_real_)]
setorder(d_dm_n, dm_lab, arm_pos)

# the groups that outcomes are summarised over: the platform, then each arm
# within each domain
d_grp <- rbind(
  data.table(Domain = "Platform", Arm = "All randomised", ids = list(d_pt$StudyPtID)),
  data.table(
    Domain = as.character(d_arm$dm_lab),
    Arm    = d_arm$arm,
    ids    = mapply(
      function(code, a) d_dm[dm == code & arm == a, StudyPtID],
      d_arm$dm, d_arm$arm, SIMPLIFY = FALSE
    )
  )
)
```

```{r}
cat(sprintf(
  "\\renewcommand{\\datacut}{Data extract: %s%s}\n",
  fmt_date(dt_cut),
  if (is_dummy) " \\textbf{\\textcolor{red}{(DUMMY DATA)}}" else ""
))
```

# Introduction

```{r}
#| output: asis
if (is_dummy) {
  cat("\\begin{center}\\fbox{\\parbox{0.9\\textwidth}{\\centering\\textbf{DUMMY DATA.} ",
      "This report has been produced from simulated data to develop the report ",
      "structure. No figure or count in this version relates to real participants.}}",
      "\\end{center}\n")
}
```

This report has been prepared for the Data and Safety Monitoring Committee (DSMC) of the ROADMAP platform trial. ROADMAP is a randomised platform trial in prosthetic joint infection (PJI). Participants can be randomised within one or more treatment domains. This report describes enrolment into the platform and domains, the current length of follow-up, baseline characteristics, the primary outcome and its components, and the antibiotic changes and suspected adverse reactions recorded at day `r l_cfg$d100$day`. Only descriptive summaries only are provided.

**Population.** Randomised participants are included. A participant is counted as randomised to the platform when their platform eligibility assessment has the outcome *Randomised*; test site data and enrolments subsequently identified as invalid are excluded. Participants who were not included, excluded due to being invalid or test records, or whose assessment is pending are not analysed further but are shown in the participant flow diagram (@fig-consort).

**Domains.** The platform has `r length(dm_codes)` domains (@tbl-domains). The domains are not independent. Whether a participant is eligible for a domain depends on their clinical course. Specifically, participants receiving one-stage revision may enter into the antibiotic duration (AB Dur A) domain and participants receiving two-stage revision may enter into the extended prophylaxis domain (AB Dur B). Participants may be randomised within valid combinations of domains. Both the platform level and the domain level views are presented. Randomisation is performed at the platform level; the allocation for a domain is revealed only once entry into that domain has been confirmed and consented, and participants are counted within a domain from that point.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-domains
#| tbl-cap: "ROADMAP treatment domains and randomised arms."
#| tbl-pos: 'H'

d_dom_tab <- d_arm[, .(Arms = paste(arm, collapse = " vs ")), by = .(dm, dm_lab)]
setnames(d_dom_tab, c("dm", "dm_lab"), c("Code", "Domain"))

kbl(d_dom_tab, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, align = "lll") |>
  kable_styling(font_size = 9)
```

**Data.** Data are from the extract dated `r fmt_date(dt_cut)` (extract label `r extract_dttm`).

# Participant flow

```{r}
#| label: consort-prep

# Counts for the flow diagram. Screening comes from l_dat. Allocation at
# platform randomisation is held in the participant list (l_pt$d_pt_alloc) and
# is only revealed once entry into the domain is confirmed and consented.
d_alloc <- l_pt$d_pt_alloc

cs <- list(
  screened  = l_dat$n_screened,
  registry  = l_dat$n_registry,
  not_elig  = l_dat$n_not_eligible,
  pending   = l_dat$n_pending,
  platform  = l_dat$n_randomised,   # randomised to the platform
  pop       = n_rand,               # in this report (in the participant list)
  allocated = uniqueN(d_alloc$StudyPtID),
  entered   = uniqueN(d_alloc[revealed == TRUE, StudyPtID])
)
cs$not_rand    <- cs$screened - cs$platform
cs$not_in_list <- cs$platform - cs$pop
cs$no_alloc    <- cs$pop - cs$allocated
cs$not_entered <- cs$allocated - cs$entered

# each step should account for everyone from the step above
stopifnot(
  cs$not_rand == cs$registry + cs$not_elig + cs$pending,
  cs$not_in_list >= 0, cs$no_alloc >= 0, cs$not_entered >= 0
)

# by domain: allocated at platform randomisation, and entered (the allocation has
# been revealed). The numbers entered are those in the domain summaries.
d_cs_dm <- merge(
  unique(d_arm[, .(dm, dm_lab)]),
  d_alloc[, .(n_alloc = .N, n_entered = sum(revealed)), by = dm],
  by = "dm", all.x = TRUE
)
for (cc in c("n_alloc", "n_entered")) set(d_cs_dm, which(is.na(d_cs_dm[[cc]])), cc, 0L)
d_cs_dm <- d_cs_dm[match(dm_codes, dm)]
stopifnot(all(d_cs_dm$n_entered == d_dm_n[, .(n = sum(N)), keyby = dm][d_cs_dm$dm, n]))
```

```{r}
#| label: consort-fn

# Helpers to draw a flow diagram on a 0 to 100 canvas. A box is centred on (x, y)
# with a bold title and plain body text, and its height follows the number of
# lines of text. The text size and line height are in the same units as the canvas.
fl_size <- 7.5 / .pt     # text size, 7.5pt
fl_lh   <- 1.5           # height of a line of text
fl_pad  <- 2.6           # space around the text in a box

flow_box <- function(id, x, y, w, title, body = character(), fill = "white") {
  n_t <- length(title)
  n_b <- length(body)
  h   <- (n_t + n_b) * fl_lh + fl_pad
  top <- y + h / 2 - fl_pad / 2
  data.table(
    id = id, x = x, y = y, w = w, h = h, fill = fill,
    title = paste(title, collapse = "\n"),
    body  = paste(body, collapse = "\n"),
    has_body = n_b > 0,
    y_title = top - n_t * fl_lh / 2,
    y_body  = top - n_t * fl_lh - n_b * fl_lh / 2
  )
}

flow_seg <- function(x, y, xend, yend, arrow = TRUE) {
  data.table(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, arrow = arrow)
}

flow_draw <- function(d_box, d_seg) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_segment(
      data = d_seg[arrow == FALSE], aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
      linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey30"
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = d_seg[arrow == TRUE], aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
      linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey30",
      arrow = arrow(length = unit(1.6, "mm"), type = "closed")
    ) +
    geom_rect(
      data = d_box,
      aes(xmin = x - w / 2, xmax = x + w / 2, ymin = y - h / 2, ymax = y + h / 2, fill = fill),
      colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_text(data = d_box, aes(x, y_title, label = title),
              fontface = "bold", size = fl_size, lineheight = 1) +
    geom_text(data = d_box[has_body == TRUE], aes(x, y_body, label = body),
              size = fl_size, lineheight = 1) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_void()
}
```

@fig-consort shows the flow of participants from screening to randomisation to the platform, and from the platform to the domains and the arms within each domain. Participants can be allocated to more than one domain, so the numbers for the domains are not additive.

```{r}
#| label: fig-consort
#| fig-cap: "Flow of participants from screening to the platform, the domains and the arms within each domain. Allocated: allocated to the domain at platform randomisation. Entered: entry into the domain confirmed and consented, so the allocation is revealed. The numbers for the arms are participants that have entered the domain."
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 7.6

# ---- layout ----------------------------------------------------------------
# main column of boxes from top to bottom. The box for those not in the
# participant list is only needed if some randomised participants are missing.
spine   <- c("screened", "platform", if (cs$not_in_list > 0) "pop",
             "allocated", "entered", "domain", "arm")
y_lv    <- setNames(seq(94, 8, length.out = length(spine)), spine)
id_pop  <- if (cs$not_in_list > 0) "pop" else "platform"

x0 <- 50;  w0 <- 38            # main column
x_side <- 85;  w_side <- 27    # side boxes
k    <- length(dm_codes)
x_dm <- (seq_len(k) - 0.5) * 100 / k
w_dm <- 100 / k - 1
n_t  <- function(n) paste0("n = ", fmt_n(n))

# ---- boxes -----------------------------------------------------------------
l_box <- list(
  flow_box("screened", x0, y_lv[["screened"]], w0, "Screened", n_t(cs$screened), "grey93"),
  flow_box("platform", x0, y_lv[["platform"]], w0, "Randomised to the platform", n_t(cs$platform), "grey93"),
  if (cs$not_in_list > 0) {
    flow_box("pop", x0, y_lv[["pop"]], w0, "Randomised participants in this report", n_t(cs$pop), "grey93")
  },
  flow_box("allocated", x0, y_lv[["allocated"]], w0,
           c("Allocated to one or", "more domains"), n_t(cs$allocated), "grey93"),
  flow_box("entered", x0, y_lv[["entered"]], w0,
           c("Entered one or more domains", "(allocation revealed)"), n_t(cs$entered), "grey93")
)

# domains, and the arms within each domain
for (i in seq_len(k)) {
  l_box <- c(l_box, list(flow_box(
    paste0("dm", i), x_dm[i], y_lv[["domain"]], w_dm, as.character(d_cs_dm$dm_lab[i]),
    c(paste("Allocated:", fmt_n(d_cs_dm$n_alloc[i])),
      paste("Entered:", fmt_n(d_cs_dm$n_entered[i]))),
    "#DCEAF5"
  )))
  d_a <- d_dm_n[dm == d_cs_dm$dm[i]][order(arm_pos)]
  w_a <- w_dm / nrow(d_a)
  x_a <- x_dm[i] + (seq_len(nrow(d_a)) - (nrow(d_a) + 1) / 2) * w_a
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(d_a))) {
    l_box <- c(l_box, list(flow_box(
      paste0("arm", i, "_", j), x_a[j], y_lv[["arm"]], w_a - 0.6,
      strsplit(paste(strwrap(d_a$arm[j], 13), collapse = "\n"), "\n")[[1]],
      n_t(d_a$N[j]), c("#CFE3F2", "#FBE8C4")[d_a$arm_pos[j]]
    )))
  }
}

# side boxes, between the two boxes that they sit between
l_side <- Filter(Negate(is.null), list(
  list(from = "screened", to = "platform",
       title = paste0("Not randomised (n = ", fmt_n(cs$not_rand), ")"),
       body = c(paste("Registry:", fmt_n(cs$registry)),
                paste("Not eligible:", fmt_n(cs$not_elig)),
                paste("Assessment pending:", fmt_n(cs$pending)))),
  if (cs$not_in_list > 0) {
    list(from = "platform", to = "pop",
         title = "Not in the participant list", body = n_t(cs$not_in_list))
  },
  list(from = id_pop, to = "allocated",
       title = "Not allocated to a domain", body = n_t(cs$no_alloc)),
  list(from = "allocated", to = "entered",
       title = "Allocation not revealed", body = n_t(cs$not_entered))
))

d_box <- rbindlist(l_box)
top_of    <- function(bid) d_box[id == bid, y + h / 2]
bottom_of <- function(bid) d_box[id == bid, y - h / 2]

# ---- connectors ------------------------------------------------------------
l_seg <- list()
main  <- spine[spine %in% c("screened", "platform", "pop", "allocated", "entered")]

# down the main column, with a side box branching from each step
for (i in seq_len(length(main) - 1)) {
  l_seg[[length(l_seg) + 1]] <- flow_seg(x0, bottom_of(main[i]), x0, top_of(main[i + 1]))
}
for (sd in l_side) {
  y_mid <- (bottom_of(sd$from) + top_of(sd$to)) / 2
  d_box <- rbind(d_box, flow_box(paste0("side_", sd$from), x_side, y_mid, w_side, sd$title, sd$body, "white"))
  l_seg[[length(l_seg) + 1]] <- flow_seg(x0, y_mid, x_side - w_side / 2, y_mid)
}

# entered -> each domain
y_bus <- (bottom_of("entered") + max(top_of("dm1"))) / 2
l_seg[[length(l_seg) + 1]] <- flow_seg(x0, bottom_of("entered"), x0, y_bus, arrow = FALSE)
l_seg[[length(l_seg) + 1]] <- flow_seg(min(x_dm), y_bus, max(x_dm), y_bus, arrow = FALSE)
for (i in seq_len(k)) {
  l_seg[[length(l_seg) + 1]] <- flow_seg(x_dm[i], y_bus, x_dm[i], top_of(paste0("dm", i)))
}

# each domain -> its arms
for (i in seq_len(k)) {
  d_arms <- d_box[grepl(paste0("^arm", i, "_"), id)]
  y_bus2 <- (bottom_of(paste0("dm", i)) + max(d_arms$y + d_arms$h / 2)) / 2
  l_seg[[length(l_seg) + 1]] <- flow_seg(x_dm[i], bottom_of(paste0("dm", i)), x_dm[i], y_bus2, arrow = FALSE)
  l_seg[[length(l_seg) + 1]] <- flow_seg(min(d_arms$x), y_bus2, max(d_arms$x), y_bus2, arrow = FALSE)
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(d_arms))) {
    l_seg[[length(l_seg) + 1]] <- flow_seg(d_arms$x[j], y_bus2, d_arms$x[j], d_arms$y[j] + d_arms$h[j] / 2)
  }
}

flow_draw(d_box, rbindlist(l_seg))
```

# Platform enrolment

As at the data extract, `r fmt_n(n_rand)` participants had been randomised to the platform from `r n_sites` recruiting sites. The first participant was randomised on `r fmt_date(dt_first)` and the most recent on `r fmt_date(dt_last)`. Randomisation over time is shown in @fig-enrol.

```{r}
#| label: fig-enrol
#| fig-cap: "Platform randomisation over time. Top: cumulative number of participants randomised. Bottom: number randomised per calendar month."
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 4.4

# daily counts -> cumulative step line, extended to the data cut
d_cum <- d_pt[, .N, keyby = dt_rand][, cum := cumsum(N)]
d_cum <- rbind(d_cum, data.table(dt_rand = dt_cut, N = 0L, cum = n_rand))

# monthly counts including months with no randomisations
month_start <- function(d) as.Date(format(d, "%Y-%m-01"))
d_mon <- data.table(month = seq(month_start(dt_first), month_start(dt_cut), by = "month"))
d_mon <- merge(d_mon, d_pt[, .N, by = .(month = month_start(dt_rand))],
               by = "month", all.x = TRUE)
d_mon[is.na(N), N := 0L]

x_scale <- scale_x_date(
  limits      = c(month_start(dt_first), dt_cut),
  date_breaks = "3 months",
  date_labels = "%b\n%Y",
  expand      = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
)

p_cum <- ggplot(d_cum, aes(dt_rand, cum)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 0.7, colour = "#0072B2") +
  x_scale +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt_n, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cumulative randomised")

p_mon <- ggplot(d_mon, aes(month, N)) +
  geom_col(width = 25, fill = "#0072B2") +
  x_scale +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = fmt_n, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = "Month of randomisation", y = "Randomised per month")

p_cum / p_mon
```

## Participation in domains

```{r}
#| label: combos

# the domains that each participant was allocated to at platform randomisation
d_asg <- l_pt$d_pt_alloc[, .(StudyPtID, dm = factor(dm, levels = dm_codes))]
setorder(d_asg, StudyPtID, dm)


d_combo_pt <- d_asg[, .(combo = paste(dm, collapse = " + "), k = .N), by = StudyPtID]
d_combo    <- d_combo_pt[, .N, by = .(combo, k)]
setorder(d_combo, -N, k, combo)
d_combo[, combo := factor(combo, levels = rev(combo))]

n_in_dm   <- nrow(d_combo_pt)
n_no_dm   <- n_rand - n_in_dm
```

Of the `r fmt_n(n_rand)` randomised participants, `r fmt_n(n_in_dm)` (`r fmt_pct(n_in_dm / n_rand, 1)`) have been allocated to at least one domain at platform randomisation and `r fmt_n(n_no_dm)` have not been allocated to a domain. @fig-combos shows the combinations of domains that participants have been allocated to.

```{r}
#| label: fig-combos
#| fig-cap: "Combinations of domains that randomised participants have been allocated to at platform randomisation (participants allocated to at least one domain). SD = Surgical, AC = AB Choice, DA = AB Dur A, DB = AB Dur B."
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 3.2

ggplot(d_combo, aes(N, combo)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#0072B2", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = fmt_n(N)), hjust = -0.2, size = 2.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = "Participants", y = "Domains allocated")
```

## Randomisation by study site

Randomisations by study site are shown in @tbl-sites. Participants can be randomised within more than one domain, so the domain columns do not sum to the platform total.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sites
#| tbl-cap: "Participants randomised by study site: platform and within each domain."
#| tbl-pos: 'H'

dm_lab_chr <- as.character(unique(d_arm[, .(dm, dm_lab)])$dm_lab)

d_site <- d_pt[, .(Platform = .N), by = site]
d_site_dm <- dcast(d_dm[, .N, by = .(site, dm)], site ~ dm, value.var = "N", fill = 0L)
for (cc in setdiff(dm_codes, names(d_site_dm))) d_site_dm[, (cc) := 0L]
d_site <- merge(d_site, d_site_dm, by = "site", all.x = TRUE)
for (cc in dm_codes) set(d_site, which(is.na(d_site[[cc]])), cc, 0L)
setorder(d_site, -Platform, site)

d_site_tot <- d_site[, lapply(.SD, sum), .SDcols = c("Platform", dm_codes)]
d_site_tot[, site := "Total"]
d_site <- rbind(d_site, d_site_tot, use.names = TRUE)

d_site_tab <- d_site[, c(
  list(Site = site,
       Platform = paste0(fmt_n(Platform), " (", fmt_pct(Platform / n_rand, 1), ")")),
  lapply(.SD, fmt_n)
), .SDcols = dm_codes]

kbl(
  d_site_tab, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, align = "lrrrrr",
  col.names = c("Site", "Platform, n (%)", dm_lab_chr)
) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 2, "Randomised within domain, n" = length(dm_codes))) |>
  kable_styling(font_size = 9) |>
  row_spec(nrow(d_site_tab) - 1, extra_latex_after = "\\midrule") |>
  row_spec(nrow(d_site_tab), bold = TRUE)
```

# Domain summaries

```{r}
#| label: dm-helpers

# one-line summary of randomised numbers by arm, for inline use
dm_txt <- function(code) {
  x <- d_dm_n[dm == code]
  arms <- paste0(fmt_n(x$N), " to ", x$arm, collapse = ", ")
  paste0(fmt_n(x$N_dm[1]), " participants have been randomised in the ",
         x$dm_lab[1], " domain: ", arms, ".")
}

# two panel figure for a domain:
# A) randomised by arm; B) cumulative randomised by arm
fig_dm <- function(code) {
  x   <- d_dm_n[dm == code]
  col <- setNames(cols_arm[x$arm_pos], x$arm)

  p_a <- ggplot(x, aes(factor(arm, levels = arm), N, fill = arm)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = paste0(N, " (", fmt_pct(prop), ")")),
      vjust = -0.4, size = 2.8
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = col, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Participants randomised", title = "A. By arm")

  # cumulative by arm over platform randomisation date, carried to the data cut
  y <- d_dm[dm == code, .N, keyby = .(arm, dt_rand)]
  y[, cum := cumsum(N), by = arm]
  y <- rbind(
    y,
    data.table(arm = x$arm, dt_rand = dt_cut, N = 0L, cum = x$N)[arm %in% x$arm],
    fill = TRUE
  )
  y[, arm := factor(arm, levels = x$arm)]

  p_b <- ggplot(y, aes(dt_rand, cum, colour = arm)) +
    geom_step(linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = col, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 months", date_labels = "%b\n%Y") +
    labs(
      x = "Date of platform randomisation",
      y = "Cumulative randomised",
      title = "B. Cumulative over time"
    )

  p_a + p_b + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.6))
}

fig_note <- paste(
  ""
)
```

# Current week of study

@fig-weeks shows the current week of study for randomised participants at the extract date, for the platform and within each domain. Study week is the number of completed weeks since platform randomisation. The dashed line marks week `r round(po_day / 7)` (day `r po_day`), the time of the primary outcome.


# Baseline characteristics

```{r}
#| label: dict-fn

# Helpers for a table of the variables in a data dictionary (see dict_var() in
# the extract script), with a column for each group of participants. They are
# used for the baseline data and for the day 100 form.

n_pct <- function(n, N) {
  if (N == 0) return("--")
  paste0(fmt_n(n), " (", formatC(100 * n / N, format = "f", digits = 1), "\\%)")
}
fmt_q <- function(x) format(round(x, 1), trim = TRUE, nsmall = 0)
ind <- "\\hspace{1em}"

# the participants in x that a variable applies to: all of them, or those with Yes
# for the variable it depends on
dict_subset <- function(when, x) {
  if (is.na(when)) x else x[x[[when]] %in% "Yes"]
}

# prepare a dictionary for the participants in d
dict_prep <- function(vars, d) {
  vars <- copy(vars)

  # a missing row is only shown for variables with missing values
  vars[, show_miss := FALSE]
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(vars))) {
    x <- dict_subset(vars$when[i], d)
    set(vars, i, "show_miss", vars$type[i] != "text" && anyNA(x[[vars$name[i]]]))
  }

  # a heading is shown where a group of variables starts. A group of Yes/No
  # variables reports n (%) in its heading
  vars[, new_group := !is.na(group) & (is.na(shift(group)) | group != shift(group))]
  vars[, group_bin := all(type %in% c("bin", "text")), by = group]
  vars
}

# the rows for one variable in the dictionary (v), summarised over the
# participants in x
dict_var_rows <- function(v, x) {

  x    <- dict_subset(v$when, x)
  vals <- x[[v$name]]
  n_ok <- sum(!is.na(vals))
  lab  <- tex_label(v$label)

  r <- switch(
    v$type,
    # numbers, and dates as the number of days
    num = , days = data.table(
      label = paste0(lab, ", median (Q1, Q3)"),
      val   = if (n_ok == 0) "--" else {
        q <- quantile(vals, c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
        paste0(fmt_q(q[2]), " (", fmt_q(q[1]), ", ", fmt_q(q[3]), ")")
      }
    ),
    # factors
    cat = rbind(
      data.table(label = paste0(lab, ", n (\\%)"), val = ""),
      data.table(
        label = paste0(ind, tex_esc(levels(vals))),
        val   = vapply(levels(vals), function(l) n_pct(sum(vals == l, na.rm = TRUE), n_ok), "")
      )
    ),
    # binary variables
    bin = data.table(label = paste0(ind, lab), val = n_pct(sum(vals == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE), n_ok)),
    # free text: only whether there is any is summarised
    text = data.table(
      label = if (v$group_bin) paste0(ind, lab) else paste0(lab, ", n (\\%)"),
      val   = n_pct(n_ok, nrow(x))
    )
  )
  if (v$show_miss) {
    r <- rbind(r, data.table(label = paste0(ind, "Missing, n"), val = fmt_n(sum(is.na(vals)))))
  }
  if (v$new_group) {
    hdr <- paste0(tex_label(v$group), if (v$group_bin) ", n (\\%)" else "")
    r <- rbind(data.table(label = paste0("\\textbf{", hdr, "}"), val = ""), r)
  }
  r
}

# A table with a column for each set of participant ids in ids_list. The rows
# are the top rows, which are a function of the participants in the column,
# then the rows for each variable in the dictionary. The variables are
# summarised over the participants that are kept by keep().
dict_cols <- function(d, vars, top_rows, ids_list, keep = identity) {
  cols <- lapply(ids_list, function(ids) {
    x <- d[StudyPtID %in% ids]
    rbind(
      top_rows(x),
      rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(vars)), function(i) dict_var_rows(vars[i], keep(x))))
    )
  })
  d_tab <- data.table(Characteristic = cols[[1]]$label)
  for (i in seq_along(cols)) set(d_tab, j = paste0("g", i), value = cols[[i]]$val)
  d_tab
}

# population/sample groups: platform, then each arm within each domain
grp_ids <- list(Platform = d_pt$StudyPtID)
grp_nm  <- "All randomised"
for (code in dm_codes) {
  for (a in d_arm[dm == code, arm]) {
    grp_ids[[paste(code, a, sep = "|")]] <- d_dm[dm == code & arm == a, StudyPtID]
    grp_nm <- c(grp_nm, a)
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: bl-prep

# Baseline data are cleaned in baseline() in the extract script. l_bl$d_bl has
# one row per randomised participant (a participant with no baseline record has
# has_bl = FALSE and missing values) and l_cfg$bl$vars is the data dictionary:
# the labels, types and groups of the variables in the order they are reported.
d_c     <- l_bl$d_bl
bl_vars <- dict_prep(l_cfg$bl$vars, d_c)

d_bl_tab <- dict_cols(
  d_c, bl_vars, ids_list = grp_ids,
  top_rows = function(x) rbind(
    data.table(label = "Randomised, n", val = fmt_n(nrow(x))),
    data.table(label = "Baseline form received, n (\\%)", val = n_pct(sum(x$has_bl), nrow(x)))
  )
)
```

## Participant characteristics

Baseline characteristics are shown in @tbl-baseline for all randomised participants and for each arm within each domain. Participants are represented in more than one domain column where they have been randomised within several domains. Continuous variables are summarised as the median (first and third quartiles) and categorical variables as the number (percentage) of participants with a recorded value. Missing values are counted separately. Participants with no baseline record are counted as missing for every variable.

## Baseline microbiology

```{r}
#| label: micro-prep

# Causative organisms are made in baseline() in the extract script: one row per
# participant and organism, so a participant has zero or more rows.
d_org <- l_bl$d_micro
det_cols <- c("pre_syn", "intra_syn", "intra_tis", "blood")   # sample types

# organisms per participant (an organism is counted once per participant)
d_org_u <- unique(d_org[, .(StudyPtID, organism)])
d_norg  <- d_org_u[, .(n_org = .N), by = StudyPtID]

# organism rows: S. aureus (any) with its subtypes, then the other organisms,
# ordered by the number of platform participants
ids_yes_all <- d_c[organism_identified %in% "Yes", StudyPtID]
org_freq <- d_org_u[StudyPtID %in% ids_yes_all, .N, by = organism][order(-N, organism)]
lab_sau  <- org_freq[grepl("aureus", organism, ignore.case = TRUE), organism]
lab_oth  <- setdiff(org_freq$organism, lab_sau)

org_def <- rbind(
  if (length(lab_sau) > 0) data.table(
    label = "Staphylococcus aureus (any)", members = list(lab_sau), indent = 1L),
  if (length(lab_sau) > 0) data.table(label = lab_sau, members = as.list(lab_sau), indent = 2L),
  if (length(lab_oth) > 0) data.table(label = lab_oth, members = as.list(lab_oth), indent = 1L)
)

mic_rows <- function(ids) {
  x <- merge(
    d_c[StudyPtID %in% ids,
        .(StudyPtID, has_bl, ident = organism_identified)],
    d_norg, by = "StudyPtID", all.x = TRUE
  )
  x[is.na(n_org), n_org := 0L]
  n_ok    <- sum(!is.na(x$ident))
  n_yes   <- sum(x$ident %in% "Yes")
  ids_yes <- x[ident %in% "Yes", StudyPtID]
  o       <- d_org_u[StudyPtID %in% ids_yes]
  n_with  <- function(k) sum(x$ident %in% "Yes" & x$n_org == k)

  rbind(
    data.table(label = "Randomised, n", val = fmt_n(nrow(x))),
    data.table(label = "Baseline form received, n (\\%)", val = n_pct(sum(x$has_bl), nrow(x))),
    data.table(label = "\\textbf{Causative organism identified, n (\\%)}", val = ""),
    data.table(
      label = paste0(ind, c("Yes", "No")),
      val   = c(n_pct(n_yes, n_ok), n_pct(sum(x$ident %in% "No"), n_ok))
    ),
    data.table(label = paste0(ind, "Missing, n"), val = fmt_n(sum(is.na(x$ident)))),
    data.table(label = "\\textbf{Organisms recorded, n (\\%) of those with an organism identified}", val = ""),
    data.table(
      label = paste0(ind, c("1", "2", "3", "None recorded")),
      val   = vapply(c(1, 2, 3, 0), function(k) n_pct(n_with(k), n_yes), "")
    ),
    data.table(label = "\\textbf{Organism, n (\\%) of those with an organism identified}", val = ""),
    data.table(
      label = paste0(strrep(ind, org_def$indent), tex_esc(org_def$label)),
      val   = vapply(org_def$members, function(m) n_pct(o[organism %in% m, uniqueN(StudyPtID)], n_yes), "")
    )
  )
}

d_mic_cols <- lapply(grp_ids, mic_rows)
d_mic_tab  <- data.table(Characteristic = d_mic_cols[[1]]$label)
for (i in seq_along(d_mic_cols)) set(d_mic_tab, j = paste0("g", i), value = d_mic_cols[[i]]$val)
```

Baseline microbiology is summarised for all randomised participants (@tbl-micro-site) and for each arm within each domain (@tbl-micro). A participant has a causative organism identified when this is recorded as Yes; up to three organisms were recorded for a participant. Organism counts are numbers of participants, so a participant with more than one organism is counted against each and the percentages can sum to more than 100%. Percentages for the number of organisms and for each organism are of participants with a causative organism identified. *Staphylococcus aureus* (any) in @tbl-micro-site combines the methicillin resistant, methicillin susceptible and penicillin susceptible categories. Species recorded in the specify fields are not tabulated separately.

@tbl-micro-site shows where each organism was detected, across all randomised participants. Each row counts organism records, so a participant with several organisms contributes several records, and a record can be positive in more than one type of sample.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-micro-site
#| tbl-cap: "Baseline organism records by type of sample in which the organism was detected (all randomised participants)."
#| tbl-pos: 'H'

det_cell <- function(v) {
  n_ok <- sum(!is.na(v))
  if (n_ok == 0) return("--")
  k <- sum(v, na.rm = TRUE)
  paste0(k, " (", fmt_pct(k / n_ok, 0), ")")
}

d_site_org <- d_org[, c(
  list(Records = .N),
  lapply(.SD, det_cell)
), by = .(label = organism), .SDcols = det_cols]
setorder(d_site_org, -Records, label)

d_site_tot <- d_org[, c(list(label = "All organism records", Records = .N), lapply(.SD, det_cell)),
                    .SDcols = det_cols]

d_site_org_tab <- rbind(
  d_site_org[, c("label", "Records", det_cols), with = FALSE],
  d_site_tot, use.names = TRUE
)
d_site_org_tab[, Records := fmt_n(Records)]

kbl(
  d_site_org_tab, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, align = "lrrrrr", linesep = "",
  col.names = c("Organism", "Records", "Pre-op synovial", "Intra-op synovial",
                "Intra-op tissue", "Blood cultures")
) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 2, "Detected in, n (% of records)" = 4)) |>
  kable_styling(font_size = 8) |>
  column_spec(1, width = "5.4cm") |>
  row_spec(nrow(d_site_org_tab) - 1, extra_latex_after = "\\midrule") |>
  row_spec(nrow(d_site_org_tab), bold = TRUE)
```

# Primary outcome

The primary outcome is treatment success at day `r po_day` (window of `r po_win` days either side) after platform randomisation. A participant is a success if they are alive, with no clinical and no microbiological evidence of infection of the index joint, and the prosthesis is in place. A participant is a failure if they have died, have clinical or microbiological evidence of infection, or the prosthesis is not in place. Where the outcome is not known to be a failure and any component is missing or unknown, the outcome would be classed as *missing* once the participant has reached day `r po_open` and as *not yet due* for any time before that. @tbl-po and @fig-po summarise the outcome for the platform and by arm within each domain.

```{r}
#| label: po-prep

# The primary outcome is made in d365() in the extract script: one row per
# randomised participant with its status (success, failure, outcome missing or
# not yet due). Join l_pt$d_pt_dm to see it by domain and arm.
d_po <- l_po$d_po

po_row <- function(ids) {
  s  <- d_po[StudyPtID %in% ids, status]
  ns <- sum(s == "Success"); nf <- sum(s == "Failure")
  data.table(
    n = length(s), succ = ns, fail = nf,
    miss = sum(s == "Outcome missing"), nyd = sum(s == "Not yet due"),
    pct = if (ns + nf > 0) fmt_pct(ns / (ns + nf), 1) else "--"
  )
}

d_po_tab <- rbindlist(c(
  list(cbind(data.table(Domain = "Platform", Arm = "All randomised"), po_row(d_pt$StudyPtID))),
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(d_arm)), function(i) {
    cbind(
      data.table(Domain = as.character(d_arm$dm_lab[i]), Arm = d_arm$arm[i]),
      po_row(d_dm[dm == d_arm$dm[i] & arm == d_arm$arm[i], StudyPtID])
    )
  })
))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-po
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'paste0("Primary outcome (treatment success at day ", po_day, ") for randomised participants: platform and by domain and arm.")'
#| tbl-pos: 'H'

d_po_show <- copy(d_po_tab)
num_cols  <- c("n", "succ", "fail", "miss", "nyd")
d_po_show[, (num_cols) := lapply(.SD, fmt_n), .SDcols = num_cols]

kbl(
  d_po_show, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE,
  align = "llrrrrrr",
  col.names = c("Domain", "Arm", "Randomised", "Success", "Failure",
                "Outcome missing", "Not yet due", "Success among known, %")
) |>
  kable_styling(font_size = 8) |>
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, latex_hline = "major", valign = "top") |>
  footnote(
    general = paste(
      "Randomised = Success + Failure + Outcome missing + Not yet due.",
      "Known outcomes are Success plus Failure; the percentage is of known outcomes.",
      paste0("Outcome missing: day ", po_open, " reached and outcome not known."),
      paste0("Not yet due: day ", po_open, " not reached and outcome not known.")
    ),
    general_title = "Note: ", threeparttable = TRUE, escape = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-po
#| fig-cap: "Primary outcome status of randomised participants by arm within each domain (proportion of participants randomised to the arm)."
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 4.2

d_fig <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(d_arm)), function(i) {
  ids <- d_dm[dm == d_arm$dm[i] & arm == d_arm$arm[i], StudyPtID]
  x <- d_po[StudyPtID %in% ids, .N, by = status]
  x <- merge(data.table(status = levels(d_po$status)), x, by = "status", all.x = TRUE)
  x[is.na(N), N := 0L]
  x[, `:=`(dm_lab = d_arm$dm_lab[i], arm_lab = paste0(d_arm$arm[i], "\n(n = ", length(ids), ")"))]
  x
}))
d_fig[, status := factor(status, levels = levels(d_po$status))]
d_fig[, arm_lab := factor(arm_lab, levels = rev(unique(arm_lab)))]

ggplot(d_fig, aes(N, arm_lab, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(position = position_fill(reverse = TRUE), width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(vars(dm_lab), ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(z) paste0(100 * z, "%"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Success = "#009E73", Failure = "#D55E00",
               `Outcome missing` = "#999999", `Not yet due` = "#E3E3E3"),
    name = NULL, drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(x = "Proportion of participants", y = NULL)
```


# Components of the primary outcome

Treatment success is a composite of four components recorded at day `r po_day`: vital status, clinical evidence of infection of the index joint, microbiological evidence of infection of the index joint and whether the prosthesis is in place. A participant is a treatment success if they are alive, with no clinical and no microbiological evidence of infection, and the prosthesis is in place. A participant is a failure if any one component has the opposite response. Each component is summarised in turn for the platform and by arm within each domain.

For each component the tables show the number of participants with each response. A participant without a response is counted as Not recorded once day `r po_open` has been reached, the start of the outcome window, and as Not yet due before that. Unknown is a recorded response of unknown. The final column is the percentage of known responses, which are those other than unknown, that have the event described in the note to the table.

```{r}
#| label: comp-prep

# The components are defined in l_cfg$d365$components and made in d365() in the
# extract script. l_po$d_po_comp has one row per participant and component, with
# the response or Not recorded / Not yet due.
d_po_comp <- l_po$d_po_comp
d_comps   <- copy(l_cfg$d365$components)

comp_cap <- function(what) paste0(what, " at day ", po_day, ": platform and by domain and arm.")

# counts of each response for one component, for each group in d_grp
comp_table <- function(comp) {
  v   <- d_comps[name == comp]
  d   <- d_po_comp[component == comp]
  lev <- c(v$levels[[1]], "Not recorded", "Not yet due")   # all of the responses

  d_tab <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(d_grp)), function(i) {
    r <- factor(d[StudyPtID %in% d_grp$ids[[i]], response], levels = lev)
    n <- setNames(as.integer(table(r)), lev)
    known <- n[[v$good]] + n[[v$bad]]
    c(
      list(Randomised = length(r)), as.list(n),
      list(pct = if (known > 0) gsub("%", "\\\\%", fmt_pct(n[[v$bad]] / known, 1)) else "--")
    )
  }))
  count_cols <- setdiff(names(d_tab), "pct")
  d_tab[, (count_cols) := lapply(.SD, fmt_n), .SDcols = count_cols]
  d_tab <- cbind(data.table(Domain = tex_esc(d_grp$Domain), Arm = tex_esc(d_grp$Arm)), d_tab)

  kbl(
    d_tab, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE,
    align = c("l", "l", rep("r", ncol(d_tab) - 2)),
    col.names = linebreak(
      c("Domain", "Arm", "Randomised", sub(" ", "\n", lev, fixed = TRUE), "Event among\nknown, \\%"),
      align = "c"
    )
  ) |>
    kable_styling(font_size = 8) |>
    collapse_rows(columns = 1, latex_hline = "major", valign = "top") |>
    footnote(
      general = paste0(
        "Event: ", v$event, ". Known responses are ", v$good, " and ", v$bad, ". ",
        "Randomised is the sum of the responses, Not recorded and Not yet due."
      ),
      general_title = "Note: ", threeparttable = TRUE
    )
}

# the responses of one component by arm within each domain, as proportions
comp_fig <- function(comp) {
  v   <- d_comps[name == comp]
  d   <- d_po_comp[component == comp]
  lev <- c(v$levels[[1]], "Not recorded", "Not yet due")   # all of the responses

  d_f <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(d_grp))[-1], function(i) {
    x <- d[StudyPtID %in% d_grp$ids[[i]], .N, by = response]
    x <- merge(data.table(response = lev), x, by = "response", all.x = TRUE)
    x[is.na(N), N := 0L]
    x[, `:=`(
      Domain  = d_grp$Domain[i],
      arm_lab = paste0(d_grp$Arm[i], "\n(n = ", length(d_grp$ids[[i]]), ")")
    )]
  }))
  d_f[, response := factor(response, levels = lev)]
  d_f[, Domain := factor(Domain, levels = unique(d_grp$Domain[-1]))]
  d_f[, arm_lab := factor(arm_lab, levels = rev(unique(arm_lab)))]

  # good, bad and unknown responses, then not recorded and not yet due
  cols <- setNames(c("#009E73", "#D55E00", "#56B4E9", "#999999", "#E3E3E3"), lev)

  ggplot(d_f, aes(N, arm_lab, fill = response)) +
    geom_col(position = position_fill(reverse = TRUE), width = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(vars(Domain), ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = function(z) paste0(100 * z, "%"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "Proportion of participants", y = NULL)
}
```

@tbl-deaths shows the participants that have died and the number of days from platform randomisation to death where the date of death is recorded. The cause of death is recorded as free text and is not summarised.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-deaths
#| tbl-cap: "Deaths and the days from platform randomisation to death: platform and by domain and arm."
#| tbl-pos: 'H'

deaths_row <- function(ids) {
  x <- d_po[StudyPtID %in% ids & vital_status %in% "Dead"]
  k <- x[!is.na(days_to_death), days_to_death]
  data.table(
    dead  = fmt_n(nrow(x)),
    dated = fmt_n(length(k)),
    days  = if (length(k) > 0) paste0(fmt_q(median(k)), " (", min(k), ", ", max(k), ")") else "--"
  )
}

d_deaths <- cbind(d_grp[, .(Domain, Arm)], rbindlist(lapply(d_grp$ids, deaths_row)))

kbl(
  d_deaths, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, align = "llrrr",
  col.names = c("Domain", "Arm", "Deaths", "Date of death recorded",
                "Days from randomisation to death, median (min, max)")
) |>
  kable_styling(font_size = 8) |>
  column_spec(4, width = "2.4cm") |>
  column_spec(5, width = "3.8cm") |>
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, latex_hline = "major", valign = "top")
```

# Antibiotic changes and suspected adverse reactions

```{r}
#| label: ar-prep

# The day 100 form is processed in d100() in the extract script: l_d100$d_ar has
# one row per randomised participant (has_d100 is FALSE if there is no form) and
# l_cfg$d100$vars is the data dictionary.
d_ar    <- l_d100$d_ar
ar_day  <- l_cfg$d100$day

# the variables are summarised over the participants that have a day 100 form
ar_vars <- dict_prep(l_cfg$d100$vars, d_ar[has_d100 == TRUE])

d_ar_tab <- dict_cols(
  d_ar, ar_vars, ids_list = grp_ids,
  # the participants without a form are not in the summaries of the variables
  keep = function(x) x[has_d100 == TRUE],
  top_rows = function(x) rbind(
    data.table(label = "Randomised, n", val = fmt_n(nrow(x))),
    data.table(
      label = paste0("Day ", ar_day, " reached, n (\\%)"),
      val   = n_pct(sum(x$days_rand >= ar_day), nrow(x))
    ),
    data.table(
      label = paste0("Day ", ar_day, " form received, n (\\% of those that reached day ", ar_day, ")"),
      val   = n_pct(sum(x$has_d100), sum(x$days_rand >= ar_day))
    ),
    data.table(
      label = "Form complete, n (\\% of forms received)",
      val   = n_pct(sum(x$complete %in% TRUE), sum(x$has_d100))
    )
  )
)
n_ar_forms <- d_ar[has_d100 == TRUE, .N]
```

The day `r ar_day` form records any change to, or cessation of, antibiotics and any suspected adverse reactions. @tbl-ar summarises these for the platform and for each arm within each domain. So far `r fmt_n(n_ar_forms)` participants have a day `r ar_day` form. The summaries are of the participants that have a form. The table shows how many participants have reached day `r ar_day` and how many forms have been received. A participant without a form is not counted as missing.

The days to the change or cessation of antibiotics, the first antibiotic changed and any other antibiotic specified are summarised for the participants with an antibiotic change or cessation only.

Participants appear in more than one domain column where they have been randomised within several domains.

# Protocol deviations

```{r}
#| label: pd-prep

# Protocol deviations are processed in deviations() in the extract script, which
# removes test sites and restricts them to the reporting population.
d_pd <- copy(l_pd$d_pd)
d_pd[, type := fifelse(is.na(type), "Not recorded", type)]

n_pd      <- nrow(d_pd)
n_pd_pt   <- uniqueN(d_pd$StudyPtID)
n_pd_site <- uniqueN(d_pd$id_prefix)
n_pd_inc  <- d_pd[complete %in% FALSE, .N]
n_pd_sb   <- d_pd[serious_breach %in% TRUE, .N]
```

Protocol deviations are recorded against a participant on a deviation form. Participants can have more than one deviation. Records from test sites are excluded.

```{r}
#| output: asis

if (n_pd == 0) {
  cat("No protocol deviations have been recorded for randomised participants as at the data extract.\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf(
    paste0(
      "As at the data extract, %s protocol deviations had been recorded for %s randomised ",
      "participants (%s of those randomised) from %s sites. %s of the deviation forms ",
      "were not complete and %s %s recorded as a serious breach. ",
      "@tbl-pd-type summarises the deviations by type and recorded outcome, @fig-pd-time ",
      "shows when they occurred, and @tbl-pd-arm shows the participants affected on the ",
      "platform and within each domain and arm.\n"
    ),
    fmt_n(n_pd), fmt_n(n_pd_pt), fmt_pct(n_pd_pt / n_rand, 1), n_pd_site,
    fmt_n(n_pd_inc), fmt_n(n_pd_sb), if (n_pd_sb == 1) "was" else "were"
  ))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-pd-type
#| tbl-cap: "Protocol deviations by type and recorded outcome."
#| tbl-pos: 'H'
#| eval: !expr n_pd > 0

pd_cell <- function(k, n) paste0(k, " (", fmt_pct(k / n, 0), ")")
pd_row <- function(x, label) {
  n <- nrow(x)
  data.table(
    Type = label,
    Deviations = fmt_n(n),
    Participants = fmt_n(uniqueN(x$StudyPtID)),
    di  = pd_cell(sum(x$data_integrity %in% TRUE), n),
    ps  = pd_cell(sum(x$pt_safety %in% TRUE), n),
    sb  = pd_cell(sum(x$serious_breach %in% TRUE), n),
    tmt = pd_cell(sum(x$tmt_agree %in% TRUE), n)
  )
}

pd_types <- d_pd[, .N, by = type][order(-N, type)]$type
pd_rows  <- list()
pd_sub   <- integer()   # row numbers of indented sub-rows
for (tp in pd_types) {
  x <- d_pd[type == tp]
  pd_rows[[length(pd_rows) + 1]] <- pd_row(x, tp)
  # where a type has a specified category, show the categories beneath it
  if (x[, any(!is.na(type_specify))]) {
    x[, spec := fifelse(is.na(type_specify), "Not specified", type_specify)]
    for (sp in x[, .N, by = spec][order(-N, spec)]$spec) {
      pd_rows[[length(pd_rows) + 1]] <- pd_row(x[spec == sp], sp)
      pd_sub <- c(pd_sub, length(pd_rows))
    }
  }
}
d_pd_tab <- rbindlist(pd_rows)
d_pd_tab <- rbind(d_pd_tab, pd_row(d_pd, "All deviations"))

# the header uses line breaks, so the cells are escaped here instead of by kbl
d_pd_tab[, Type := tex_esc(Type)]
pct_cols <- c("di", "ps", "sb", "tmt")
d_pd_tab[, (pct_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(z) gsub("%", "\\%", z, fixed = TRUE)), .SDcols = pct_cols]

kbl(
  d_pd_tab, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, align = "lrrrrrr", linesep = "",
  col.names = linebreak(
    c("Type", "Deviations", "Partici-\npants", "Data\nintegrity",
      "Participant\nsafety", "Serious\nbreach", "TMT\nagrees"),
    align = "c"
  )
) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 3, "Recorded as Yes, n (% of deviations)" = 4)) |>
  kable_styling(font_size = 8) |>
  column_spec(1, width = "4.6cm") |>
  add_indent(pd_sub) |>
  row_spec(nrow(d_pd_tab) - 1, extra_latex_after = "\\midrule") |>
  row_spec(nrow(d_pd_tab), bold = TRUE) |>
  footnote(
    general = paste(
      "TMT agrees: the trial management team agrees that the event constitutes a protocol deviation.",
      "Outcomes that are not recorded (for example on incomplete forms) are not counted as Yes."
    ),
    general_title = "Note: ", threeparttable = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-pd-time
#| fig-cap: "Protocol deviations by month of deviation and type."
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 3
#| eval: !expr n_pd > 0

pd_x0 <- min(month_start(dt_first), month_start(min(d_pd$dt_deviation, na.rm = TRUE)))
d_pd_m <- data.table(month = seq(pd_x0, month_start(dt_cut), by = "month"))
d_pd_n <- d_pd[!is.na(dt_deviation), .N, by = .(month = month_start(dt_deviation), type)]
d_pd_n[, type := factor(type, levels = pd_types)]

ggplot(d_pd_n, aes(month, N, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(width = 25) +
  scale_x_date(
    limits = c(pd_x0 - 15, dt_cut), date_breaks = "3 months", date_labels = "%b\n%Y"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = function(l) { b <- pretty(l); b[b == floor(b)] },
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = setNames(c("#0072B2", "#E69F00", "#009E73", "#999999")[seq_along(pd_types)], pd_types),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(x = "Month of deviation", y = "Deviations")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-pd-arm
#| tbl-cap: "Participants with at least one protocol deviation: platform and by domain and arm."
#| tbl-pos: 'H'
#| eval: !expr n_pd > 0

pd_grp <- function(ids) {
  x <- d_pd[StudyPtID %in% ids]
  k <- uniqueN(x$StudyPtID)
  data.table(
    n = fmt_n(length(ids)),
    k = paste0(fmt_n(k), " (", fmt_pct(k / length(ids), 1), ")"),
    dev = fmt_n(nrow(x))
  )
}

d_pd_arm <- rbindlist(c(
  list(cbind(data.table(Domain = "Platform", Arm = "All randomised"), pd_grp(d_pt$StudyPtID))),
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(d_arm)), function(i) {
    cbind(
      data.table(Domain = as.character(d_arm$dm_lab[i]), Arm = d_arm$arm[i]),
      pd_grp(d_dm[dm == d_arm$dm[i] & arm == d_arm$arm[i], StudyPtID])
    )
  })
))

kbl(
  d_pd_arm, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, align = "llrrr",
  col.names = c("Domain", "Arm", "Randomised", "With a deviation, n (%)", "Deviations")
) |>
  kable_styling(font_size = 9) |>
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, latex_hline = "major", valign = "top") |>
  footnote(
    general = paste(
      "Deviations are recorded against the participant and are not attributed to a domain.",
      "A participant randomised within more than one domain appears in each."
    ),
    general_title = "Note: ", threeparttable = TRUE
  )
```
